note: Independent re-audit after 26d70dfa0d. onLLGRFamilyExpired and onLLGRComplete now send purge-stale and release-routes through dispatchRetained to every connection the retained cycle holds, earlier ones first; for a single restart that is the source alone, so TestLLSTTimerExpiry_SingleFamily, TestRFC9494LLSTExpiryDeletesTheFamilysStaleRoutes (exact IPv4 purge, no IPv6 purge) and TestRFC9494DelayedDownPreservesLLSTDeadlines (both polarities, real RIB, 1ns either side of each family's deadline) keep their full force. The commit adds both polarities on TestRFC9494ConsecutiveRestartExpiryDeletesEveryConnectionsRoutes: after a second restart during LLGR, the real RIB holds all three routes of connections 41 and 42 at level 2 with LLGR_STALE one nanosecond before the original deadline and none at it, so reverting dispatchRetained to the latest connection leaves 41's route and goes red. The RIB side (earlierRetainedLocked, retainsEarlier keeping an emptied earlier connection known) answers a zero purge rather than refusing. The whole sentence, every stale route of the family from the neighbor, is covered for both the single and the consecutive case.
